title: Summer on the Hill
setting: A green hill by the sea, with a farm, trees and fields.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: Raj, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt

sentences.en: In summer, Zoe and Raj walk up a hill.
sentences.zh: 夏天，佐伊和拉吉走上一座小山。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt walk up a green hill under a bright summer sun.

sentences.en: Below them, men fish in the beautiful sea.
sentences.zh: 在他们下方，人们在美丽的海里捕鱼。
sentences.scene_prompt: From the hilltop, Zoe, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt look down at fishermen in a small boat on a beautiful blue sea.

sentences.en: A plane flies north over the blue water.
sentences.zh: 一架飞机飞过蓝色的海面向北飞去。
sentences.scene_prompt: A plane flies high over the blue sea while Zoe, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt point at it.

sentences.en: Sheep and cows eat grass under a tree.
sentences.zh: 绵羊和奶牛在一棵树下吃草。
sentences.scene_prompt: White sheep and brown cows eat grass under a big tree on the hill.

sentences.en: A brown rabbit runs past their feet.
sentences.zh: 一只棕色的兔子从他们脚边跑过。
sentences.scene_prompt: A brown rabbit runs past the feet of Zoe, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt and Raj, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt on the grass.

sentences.en: Near the farm, a cat watches a mouse.
sentences.zh: 农场附近，一只猫盯着一只老鼠。
sentences.scene_prompt: A cat crouches and watches a small mouse near a farm wall.

sentences.en: Raj shows his toy monkey to the sheep.
sentences.zh: 拉吉把他的玩具猴子给绵羊看。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a young boy with short black hair and a blue t-shirt holds up a toy monkey in front of a curious sheep, Zoe, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt laughing.

sentences.en: In autumn, all the flowers on the hill die.
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，山上的花全都凋谢了。
sentences.scene_prompt: The same hill in autumn, with dry brown flowers and orange leaves.
